title: I’ll see you in my dreams, a meeting of souls-spoiler: no one shows
content: I left this in a comment, but it’s honestly the clearest I have been able to articulate my thoughts- I’m new to this Mall World idea. But I will say my entire life, I have had vivid dreams that FEEL, 100% real. I am always Going back to the same places. I have asked different people through out life, do you think we “meet” up w people in our dreams? When I was younger I used to always tell people I truly cared for, “I will see you in my dreams, meet me there-“ Interactions, feel real. 100%. I wake up incredibly emotional at times from things that happened in my dreams. I believe it’s a connection of minds away from the body- multiverse? Maybe? But I also think, a lot of folks are not tapped in, dismiss it off, or somehow remain unaffected and unaware. As a child I had a dream dictionary, I have been trying to figure this out, as long as I can remember. But it seems, there has to be more to dreams then just what a dictionary covers. I truly believe in the meeting of souls in dreams, however, I’m left wondering why, who I’m meeting in my dreams, seems to be- either unaware or unbothered by these dream interactions. This has always caught me up- I’m guessing they are not tapped in- or I have thought about this wayyyy too much on my own. I recently started painting some of the places I visit- trying to make a dream map of sorts. I believe we have, Interconnected dreams, somehow- however I have no proof, not a single person I can say I have “shared a dream” with. I wonder if anyone else has shared this line of thinking with similar vivid dreaming or what are your thoughts? (Photo from Google search)
